summary: Surah 71 ayahs 1-28: all 7 high/medium findings, 6 low findings and the SEM sample of all 13 books recorded. All findings were false positives (back-references to 71:21, orthography, translator-note length). One minor source defect: mekki-muskil:6-6 also comments on 71:7 (noted in TR/EN). GAPs recorded for 7 books where the source does not comment.
